name: run_id
description: UUID identifying the Cloud Function invocation that owned this window

name: started_at
description: Wall-clock time the window started processing

name: finished_at
description: Wall-clock time the window finished (success or captured failure)

name: status
description: 'ok' once the window committed cleanly; 'error' for captured failures. OOMs leave no row.

name: sync_start
description: Inclusive lower bound of the Gmail after: filter for this window

name: sync_end
description: Exclusive upper bound of the Gmail before: filter. Next run's floor = MAX(sync_end) WHERE status='ok'.

name: fetched
description: Number of Gmail messages enumerated in the window

name: inserted
description: Number of new rows written to gmail_messages (after dedup)

name: error
description: Stringified exception when status='error', else NULL
